title: Consult an advisor without transferring task ownership
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Sparse advisor counsel helps at hard boundaries while the active executor keeps ownership. Budgets stop routine consultation. Accepts inspiration requirement 18[^insp-r18].
implementation: `Advisor` / `AdvisorPolicy` in `mechaharness.advisor` are distinct from `GraphEscalation` (ownership transfer). `DefaultAdvisorPolicy` rate-limits consultations; `consult_advisor` records `AdvisorObservation` and never transfers task ownership. Default DI binds `RejectAdvisor` with an explicit continue fallback.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
